summary: I checked tonight's Nations League games (Spain-Croatia, England-Czechia), the USA-Canada friendly, Bitcoin and Ethereum prices against today's threshold markets, NHL injury reports for Blues-Blackhawks and Panthers-Kings, the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize field, Elon Musk's tweet count, and fresh news on the Brazil runoff. Spain's 80 cent price to beat Croatia matches bookmaker odds almost exactly, England's absences are backups already reflected in its price, and Bitcoin and Ethereum are trading right near their threshold lines so those markets look fairly priced. Canada is missing six regulars including captain Alphonso Davies against the USA, but Canada has still kept clean sheets this window with that same thin squad, so I could not build enough confidence to bet. Nobel odds for Save the Children and Mykola Kuleba come in around 9 to 12 percent on other trackers versus 7 to 10 cents here, which is too small a gap after fees, and the Brazil runoff news only confirms my existing Lula position's thesis that the race is close, so I am holding everything with zero trades this cycle.
